verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच ।
          ततः शान्तनवो भीष्मो निर्ययौ सह सेनया ।  व्यूहं चाव्यूहत महत् सर्वतोभद्रमात्मनः ॥१॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said Thereafter, Bhishma the son of Shantanu advanced with his troops, and he formed his own troops in the array known as Saravatobhadra.

verses.sanskrit: कृपश्च कृतवर्मा च शैब्यश्चैव महारथः ।  शकुनिः सैन्धवश्चैव काम्बोजश्च सुदक्षिणः ॥२॥
verses.english: Kripa, Kritavarma, the mighty car-warrior Shaivya, Shakuni, the ruler of the Sindhus, and Sudakshina, the ruler of the Kambojas,

verses.sanskrit: भीष्मेण सहिताः सर्वे पुत्रैश्च तव भारत ।  अग्रतः सर्वसैन्यानां व्यूहस्य प्रमुखे स्थिताः ॥३॥
verses.english: All these, O Bharata, accompanied by Bhishma, and along with your sons stationed themselves in the van of all the troops, and in the very head of the Kaurava array.

verses.sanskrit: द्रोणो भूरिश्रवाः शल्यो भगदत्तश्च मारिष ।  दक्षिणं पक्षमाश्रित्य स्थिता व्यूहस्य दंशिताः ॥४॥
verses.english: Drona, Bhurishravas, Shalya and Bhagadatta. O sire, clad in mail, stood defending the right wing of that array.

verses.sanskrit: अश्वत्थामा सोमदत्तश्चावन्त्यौ च महारथौ ।  महत्या सेनया युक्ता वामं पक्षमपालयन् ॥५॥
verses.english: Ashvathama, Somadatta, and the two princes of Avanti, both mighty car-warriors, supported by a large division, defended the left wing.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्योधनो महाराज त्रिगर्तैः सर्वतो वृतः ।  व्यूहमध्ये स्थितो राजन् पाण्डवान् प्रति भारत ॥६॥
verses.english: King Duryodhana, surrounded by the Trigaretas on all sides, stood, O monarch, O Bharata, in the centre of the array facing the Pandavas.

verses.sanskrit: अलम्बुषो रथश्रेष्ठः श्रुतायुश्च महारथः ।  पृष्ठतः सर्वसैन्यानां स्थितौ व्यूहस्य दंशितौ ॥७॥
verses.english: That foremost of car-warriors Alambusha, and the mighty car-warrior Shrutayu, cased in Armour, stood in the rear of the array behind all the troops.

verses.sanskrit: एवं च तं तदा व्यूहं कृत्वा भारत तावकाः।  सन्नद्धाः समदृश्यन्त प्रतपन्त इवाग्नयः ॥८॥
verses.english: Thus, O Bharata, your warriors, having formed this mighty array and cased in Armour, appeared as if leaping forward.

verses.sanskrit: ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा भीमसेनश्च पाण्डवः ।  नकुलः सहदेवश्च माद्रीपुत्रावुभावपि ॥९॥
verses.english: Then king Yudhishthira and that son of Pandu, Bhimasena, and Nakula and Sahadeva the two sons of Madri,

verses.sanskrit: अग्रतः सर्वसैन्यानां स्थिता व्यूहस्य दंशिताः ।  धृष्टद्युम्नो विराटश्च सात्यकिश्च महारथः ॥१०॥
verses.english: All cased in mail, stood in the van of their array at the front of all the troops. Dhrishtadyumna, Virata, the mighty carwarrior Satyaki.

verses.sanskrit: स्थिताः सैन्येन महता परानीकविनाशनाः ।  शिखण्डी विजयश्चैव राक्षसश्च घटोत्कचः ॥११॥
verses.english: All these warriors stood prepared for battle, with their mighty divisions desirous of destroying the ranks of the enemy. Shikhandin, Arjuna, the Rakshasa Ghatotkacha,

verses.sanskrit: चेकितानो महाबाहुः कुन्तिभोजश्च वीर्यवान् ।  स्थिता रणे महाराज महत्या सेनया वृताः ॥१२॥
verses.english: The mighty-armed Chekitana, the highly puissant Kuntibhoja, all these, o mighty monarch, stood ready for fight, surrounded by their large divisions.

verses.sanskrit: अभिमन्युर्महेष्वासो द्रुपदश्च महाबलः ।  युयुधानो महेष्वासो युधामन्युश्च वीर्यवान् ॥१३॥
verses.english: That fierce bow-man Abhimanyu, the highly powerful Draupada, and the Kaikeya brothers, cased in Armour, stood ready for combat.

verses.sanskrit: केकया भ्रातरश्चैव स्थिता युद्धाय दंशिताः ।  एवं तेऽपि महाव्यूहं प्रतिव्यूह्य सुदुर्जयम् ॥१४॥
verses.english: Thus the heroic Pandavas forming this mighty and invincible contrary, stood, cased in mail, prepared for the ensuing struggle.

verses.sanskrit: पाण्डवाः समरे शूराः स्थिता युद्धाय दंशिताः ।  तावकास्तु रणे यत्ताः सहसेना नराधिपाः ॥१५॥
verses.english: Your warriors, o king, supported by large divisions and placing Bhishma at their head, charged, putting forth all their energies, the sons of Pritha on the field.

verses.sanskrit: अभ्युद्ययू रणे पार्थान् भीष्मं कृत्वाऽग्रतो नृप ।  तथैव पाण्डवा राजन् भीमसेनपुरोगमाः ॥१६॥
verses.english: So also, O king, the Pandavas headed by Bhimasena himself, and desirous of wining victory, rushed to battle with a view to cncounter Bhishma.

verses.sanskrit: भीष्मं योद्धुमभीप्सन्तः संग्रामे विजयैषिणः ।  क्ष्वेडाः किलकिलाः शङ्खान् क्रकचान् गोविषाणिकाः ॥१७॥
verses.english: With their war-cries and confused uproars and the blarc of Krakachas and sound of drums, cymbals, cow-horns, and panavas, and the roars of their elephants.

verses.sanskrit: भेरी-मृदङ्ग-पणवान्नादयन्तश्च पुष्करान् ।  पाण्डवा अभ्यवर्तन्त नदन्तो भैरवान् रवान् ॥१८॥
verses.english: And with fierce yells, the Pandavas rushed to battle. With the sound of our drums, cyrnbals conchs, Dundubhis,

verses.sanskrit: भेरी-मृदङ्ग-शङ्खानां दुन्दुभीनां च निःस्वनः ।  उत्कृष्टसिंहनादैश्च वल्गितैश्च पृथग्विधैः ॥१९॥
verses.english: With fierce war-dries, and other kinds of shouts, hastily did we advance to meet the foe,

verses.sanskrit: वयं प्रतिनदन्तस्तानगच्छाम त्वरान्विताः ।  सहसैवाभिसंक्रुद्धास्तदासीत् तुमुलं महत् ॥२०॥
verses.english: All inflamed with rage. Thereupon ensued an awful and fierce engagement, in which the soldiers, rushing at one another, smote one another down.

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽन्योन्यं प्रधावन्तः संप्रहारं प्रचक्रिरे ।  ततः शब्देन महता प्रचकम्पे वसुन्धरा ॥२१॥
verses.english: Then the earth began to tremble with the loud din. Birds uttering fierce shrieks hovered over our heads.

verses.sanskrit: पक्षिणश्च महाघोरं व्याहरन्तो विबभ्रमुः ।  सप्रभश्चोदितः सूर्यो निष्प्रभः समपद्यत ॥२२॥
verses.english: The sun that had risen in all splendor, now became bedimmed in effulgence; and dreadful winds began to blow portending ominous results.

verses.sanskrit: ववुश्च वातास्तुमुलाः शंसन्तः सुमहद्भयम् ।  घोराश्च घोरनिर्ह्रादाः शिवास्तत्र ववाशिरे ॥२३॥
verses.english: Fearful jackets yelling terribly roved there, harbingering, Omighty monarch, a great carnage.

verses.sanskrit: वेदयन्त्यो महाराज महद्वैशसमागतम् ।  दिशः प्रज्वलिता राजन् पांसुवर्षं पपात च ॥२४॥
verses.english: The points of the compass, 0 king, appeared to be blazing, and showers of bones mixed copiously with blood.

verses.sanskrit: रुधिरेण समुन्मिश्रमस्थिवर्षं तथैव च ।  रुदतां वाहनानां च नेत्रेभ्यः प्रापतज्जलम् ॥२५॥
verses.english: Tears dropped from the eyes of the animals that were all weeping; and O ruler of men, preyed upon by anxiety, they frequently discharged urine.

verses.sanskrit: सुस्रुवुश्च शकृन्मूत्रं प्रध्यायन्तो विशांपते ।  अन्तर्हिता महानादाः श्रूयन्ते भरतर्षभ ॥२६॥
verses.english: O foremost of the Bharatas, fierce war-cries of heroes were drowned by the terrible uproar uttered by Rakshasas and cannibals.

verses.sanskrit: रक्षसां पुरुषादानां नदतां भैरवान् रवान् ।  संपतन्तश्च दृश्यन्ते गोमायुबलवायसाः ॥२७॥
verses.english: Jackals, vultures, crows and dogs yelling various shrieks, began, O sire, to pounce and swoop down the ranks of soldiers.

verses.sanskrit: श्वानश्च विविधैर्नादैर्वाशन्तस्तत्र मारिष ।  ज्वलिताश्च महोल्का वै समाहत्य दिवाकरम् ।  निपेतुः सहसा भूमौ वेदयन्त्यो महद्भयम् ॥२८॥
verses.english: Blazing meteors, striking against the solar disc, began to drop down suddenly on earth portending mighty terrors.

verses.sanskrit: महान्त्यनीकानि महासमुच्छ्रये ततस्तयोः पाण्डवधार्तराष्ट्रयोः ।  चकम्पिरे शङ्खमृदङ्गनिःस्वनैः प्रकम्पितानीव वनानि वायुना ॥२९॥
नरेन्द्रनागाश्वसमाकुलानामभ्यायतीनामशिवे मुहूर्ते ।  बभूव घोषस्तुमुलश्चमूनां वातोद्धुतानामिव सागराणाम् ॥३०॥
verses.bhavadeepa: महासमुच्छ्रये महति युद्धे । ’युद्धे समुच्छ्रयः पुमान्’ इति मेदिनी ॥२९॥
